metadata.title: The second variation of 2-spheres in the 2n-sphere
metadata.abstract: We prove sharp upper and lower bounds for the Morse index and nullity of linearly full branched minimal 2-spheres in the round 2n-sphere. In particular, we show that the Morse index of a linearly full minimal 2-sphere in the round 2n-sphere is at least n(n-1)(2n+1), with equality if and only if the 2-sphere is twistor-equivalent to the Boruvka sphere. Our techniques also apply more generally to give bounds for the Morse index and nullity for totally isotropic surfaces in the 2n-sphere.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 给出圆球 S²ⁿ 中线性满分支极小二球的 Morse 指标与零度锐上下界，证明指标至少 n(n−1)(2n+1)，并刻画等号。
analysis.breakthrough: 等号与 Boruvka 球的 twistor 等价相对应，方法还适用于更一般的全各向同性曲面。
analysis.limitations: 等号是 twistor 等价而不必是简单的环境全等；线性满与球面环境假设不可省略。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 LLM 校对稿件并辅助论证正确性检查，另提出 Boruvka 浸入中已有负变分对应§5特定丛截面的建议；主要证明策略和行文由作者完成。
